# Test fixtures — Voltix (CASE-0041)

Three files describing one and the same fictional case, at three points of the pipeline.

## `voltix.golden.html` — FROZEN

The hand-written reference report. It is the **golden master**: the target output the
renderer has to reproduce. It was authored by hand, not generated.

**Do not edit this file.** Not to fix a typo, not to reconcile a number, not to make a
test pass. If the renderer disagrees with it, the renderer is wrong until a human decides
otherwise. Changing the golden silently turns a regression into a green build.

Known internal inconsistencies in the golden (deliberately preserved, see the notes in
`voltix.reportmodel.json` below) are part of the frozen artifact.

## `voltix.reportmodel.json` — the model behind the golden

A `ReportModel` (`src/report/model.ts`), transcribed field by field from
`voltix.golden.html`. Every number and every sentence is copied from the HTML; nothing is
computed, rounded or invented here. Where the report does not supply a value that the type
requires, the field carries an empty value (`""`, `null`, `[]`) rather than a guess.

Use it as the input when asserting that the renderer produces the golden HTML.

## `voltix-brief.json` — the input that would have produced it

A `StackBrief v2` — what the client would have filled in on the intake form
(`assets/stack-tool/intake.html`, `brief()`), extended with `plan`, `unitPrice`,
`termEnds`/`termType`, `contact`, `readWhat`/`period`/`exclusions`, and per-module
`evidenceKind`/`evidenceNote`.

Tool ids, module ids and capability slugs come from `assets/stack-tool/catalog.js` (the
repo's own catalog); everything else comes from the golden report. Fields the report never
states (`industry`, `pains`, `mustKeep`) are empty strings.

## Provenance

Report currency is USD. Voltix has 34 people but 52 licensed seats across 7 tools — the
two numbers are both correct and both appear in the report.
